plusgbenchsource.title: Benchmark Source

plusgaccequinspectby.title: Inspected By

plusgpolicyid.title: Operating Policy

plusgliftequinspectby.title: Inspected By
plusgliftequinspectby.remarks: The person who inspected the lifting equipment.

plusgleakdetails.title: Leak Details
plusgleakdetails.remarks: Describes the source of the leak, and any other information about the leak.

plusdpressure.title: Meter Pressure
plusdpressure.remarks: The maximum operating pressure for the meter.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: Status of the asset, for example, not ready, operating, or decommissioned.

plusdutilitytype.title: Utility Type Code
plusdutilitytype.remarks: The utility type code that is defined in the customer billing system.

plusgtargetmtbf.title: Target MTBF
plusgtargetmtbf.remarks: The target mean time between failures for the asset, in hours. The value must be an integer.

plusghoseinspectdate.title: Last Inspection
plusghoseinspectdate.remarks: The date and time when the hose was last inspected.

plusdneedsamplewo.title: Sampling WO Needed

plusgpipprocessmedium.title: Process Medium
plusgpipprocessmedium.remarks: The type of medium, such as fuel or water, that the pipe is designed to carry.

plusgpiprating.title: Rating

plusgprotectinspectby.title: Inspected By
plusgprotectinspectby.remarks: The person who inspected the personal protective equipment.

plusgriskassessid.title: Risk Assessment Unique Identifier
plusgriskassessid.remarks: The unique identifier of the risk assessment.

plusgaccequinspectbyid.title: Inspected By ID
plusgaccequinspectbyid.remarks: The person who inspected the access equipment.

plusgprotectinspectdate.title: Last Inspection
plusgprotectinspectdate.remarks: The date and time when the personal protective equipment was last inspected.

plusdpressurewater.title: Inches of Water
plusdpressurewater.remarks: The pressure in units of inches of water

plusglastchkdate.title: Last Checked Date
plusglastchkdate.remarks: The date and time when the valve was last checked for leaks.

plusgprotectinspectbyid.title: Inspected By ID
plusgprotectinspectbyid.remarks: The person who inspected the personal protective equipment.

plusghoseinspectbyid.title: Inspected By ID
plusghoseinspectbyid.remarks: The person who inspected the hose.

plusgispassvalve.title: Passing Valve
plusgispassvalve.remarks: Specifies whether the valve is closed properly and that it is not leaking fluids or gases.

plusgaccequinspectdate.title: Last Inspection Date/Time
plusgaccequinspectdate.remarks: The date and time when the access equipment was last inspected.

plusgpipinspectby.title: Inspected By
plusgpipinspectby.remarks: The person who inspected the pipe.

plusdfulldemand.title: Full Scale Demand Value
plusdfulldemand.remarks: Maximum demand value supported by the meter in amps.

plusdmeterphase.title: Meter Phase Code
plusdmeterphase.remarks: Indicate if the meter is single phase or three phase or indicates the phase associated with the meter.

plusgfmtype.title: Failure Analysis Type
plusgfmtype.remarks: The type of procedural analysis that must be done to identify the potential failure of this asset. An FMEA analysis is done at the functional level. An FMECA analysis extends the FMEA analysis by including a criticality analysis, which identifies the potential failure of the asset and the consequences of the failure. Criticality-based maintenance identifies which assets are critical and what the impact would be if the assets were to fail. Criticality-based maintenance also informs procurement strategy so that inventories, and the costs associated with keeping them, are reduced but not at the expense of increased downtime.

plusgpiplineclass.title: Line Class
plusgpiplineclass.remarks: The classification to which the pipe is assigned.

plusghoserating.title: Rating
plusghoserating.remarks: The pressure that the hose is designed to withstand.

plusgistemp.title: Temporary
plusgistemp.remarks: Indicates whether an asset is only needed for a limited time. The asset is tracked for historical purposes.

plusgpredictedmtbf.title: Predicted MTBF
plusgpredictedmtbf.remarks: The predicted mean time between failures for the asset, in hours. The value must be an integer.

plusdbusinessunit.title: Business Unit
plusdbusinessunit.remarks: The business unit that is responsible for the asset.

plusdsamplingid.title: Internal ID
plusdsamplingid.remarks: Internal ID column used to Generate WO

plusdprimaryind.title: Primary Meter Indicator
plusdprimaryind.remarks: Indicates if the meter record is for primary metering

plusgprotecttype.title: PPE Type
plusgprotecttype.remarks: The type of personal protective equipment, such as breathing apparatus, that is used to ensure personal safety.

plusgmttr.title: MTTR
plusgmttr.remarks: The mean time to repair for the asset, in hours. This value must be an integer.

plusdmultiplier.title: Multiplier
plusdmultiplier.remarks: The meter multiplier is a billing factor that is used in the calculation of customer bills.

riskassessnum.title: Risk Assessment
riskassessnum.remarks: The identifier for the risk assessment.

plusgfasummary.title: Summary
plusgfasummary.remarks: A summary of the details of the failure analysis, such as which method is used.

plusdregtype.title: Regulatory Type
plusdregtype.remarks: The regulatory asset type which determines reporting requirements and may relate to the standards that applies to this asset record

plusgliftequrating.title: Rating
plusgliftequrating.remarks: The rating for the lifting equipment.

plusghosetype.title: Hose Type
plusghosetype.remarks: The type of hose, such as a fire hose, that is used for this asset.

plusgprotectreference.title: Reference
plusgprotectreference.remarks: The reference to documentation or to an identifier that is associated with the type of personal protective equipment that is required.

plusdsampledate.title: Last Sample Date
plusdsampledate.remarks: The last date that a sample work order was generated for this meter.

plusgpiptype.title: Piping Type
plusgpiptype.remarks: The type of piping that is used for this asset.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: Describes the asset. To enter or view additional information, click Long  Description.

plusgtotalscore.title: Total Score
plusgtotalscore.remarks: The total score that is assigned to the review actions that are associated with the asset.

plusdfixedfactor.title: Fix Factor Value
plusdfixedfactor.remarks: A billing factor that is associated with the delivery pressure.

plusgfmpersonid.title: Failure Analysis Leader ID
plusgfmpersonid.remarks: The person who is leading the failure analysis effort.

plusgbenchmarkmtbf.title: Benchmark MTBF
plusgbenchmarkmtbf.remarks: The benchmark mean time between failures for the asset, in hours. The value must be an integer.

plusgpipreference.title: Reference

plusgaccequtype.title: Access Equipment Type
plusgaccequtype.remarks: The type of equipment that provides access.

plusghoseprocessmedium.title: Process Medium
plusghoseprocessmedium.remarks: The type of medium, such as fuel or water, that the hose is designed to carry.

plusgpipinspectdate.title: Last Inspection
plusgpipinspectdate.remarks: The date and time when the pipe was last inspected.

plusddialcount.title: Dial Count
plusddialcount.remarks: The number of dials on the meter

plusgpipinspectbyid.title: Inspected By ID
plusgpipinspectbyid.remarks: The person who inspected the pipe.

plusghistoricmtbf.title: Historic MTBF
plusghistoricmtbf.remarks: The historic mean time between failures for the asset, in hours. The value must be an integer.

plusgopenomuid.title: Open Unique Idenfitier
plusgopenomuid.remarks: The open unique identifier provided to an external system by Maximo.

plusgleaking.title: Leaking
plusgleaking.remarks: Indicates whether the asset is leaking.

plusgpiplinenum.title: Line Number
plusgpiplinenum.remarks: The length of a piece of the pipe. The piece can be short or long, depending on how the pipe is constructed.

plusdequipmenttype.title: Equipment Type Code
plusdequipmenttype.remarks: The equipment type code that is defined in the customer billing system.

plusgliftequinspectdate.title: Last Inspection Date/Time
plusgliftequinspectdate.remarks: The date and time when the lifting equipment was last inspected.

plusgliftequinspectbyid.title: Inspected By ID
plusgliftequinspectbyid.remarks: The person who inspected the lifting equipment.

plusgtempuntil.title: Temporary Until

plusgdateofprediction.title: Date of Prediction
plusgdateofprediction.remarks: The date when the predicted mean time between failures was specified.

plusdsamplinggroup.title: Sampling Group
plusdsamplinggroup.remarks: The group of meters with similar characteristics that are tested as a batch.
